title: Distribor: framework-only advisor that scans spokes and interrogates teaching files to evolve framing
body: New advisor concept for the framework spoke only. Name: Distribor. Dual role: (1) SCAN — polls spokes for behavioral evidence: settings.local.json accumulation patterns, track files, teaching adoption deltas, lug type misuse. What looks like 'pollution' is actually telemetry — settings.local.json shows which commands agents ran, which paths they accessed, what had to be approved. This is behavioral signal about how teachings are executing in practice. (2) INTERROGATE — analyzes the scan data to identify gaps between intended behavior (teaching framing) and actual behavior (what agents did). Devises better framing for training/teaching files. The scan-interrogate cycle IS the evolution loop: spoke behavior → distribor reads it → teaching framing improves → better spoke behavior. Lives exclusively in the framework spoke — it is not distributed. It reads spokes; it does not instruct them directly. Output: revised teaching files and framing recommendations, surfaced to framework maintainer for formal adoption.

inputs: spoke settings.local.json (accumulated permissions as behavioral trace)
spoke track.jsonl files (what agents actually did)
teaching adoption logs (which teachings stuck, which failed, which polluted)
lug type distributions (are agents writing the right types?)
outputs: settings.local.json cleanup recommendations for affected spokes
design_notes.trigger: on-demand by framework maintainer, not automated
